title: 第二十五章       新生风云榜
content_zh:
离开学典礼结束已经过去了几天，正在床榻上冥想着，“琼霄，琼霄！”一道急促的声音从门外传来。

    “怎么了？老是这样大惊小怪！”冥想中的琼霄缓缓张开双眼，问道。

    “大事！绝对的大事！”来人正是李朗，因为在新生区域里，只有他和琼霄同住一间。

    “能有什么大事？”琼霄皱着眉头问道。

    “都说了要经常出去走走，收集一下学院里的信息！你老是待在房间里能有什么用？”

    “你懂什么？”琼霄无奈的翻了翻白眼，不是他不想出去，他如今已经接触到了玄星境，想要突破到玄星境，所以这段时间里他只能闭关修炼，虽说有着玄极丹，但是不好好修炼，纵使有着玄极丹，突破的几率也很小，所以他不能分心。

    “想不想听听？”李朗嘴角微微翘起，笑道。

    “赶紧的，有啥大事，别老是吊我胃口！”琼霄扯着李朗的衣襟咆哮道。

    “额，能不能不要这么粗鲁？”李朗无语道。

    “谁叫你那小子不老实，赶紧说说，搞得我好奇心都起来了！”

    “好好！我说！你知道学院新生风云榜吗？”李朗笑道。

    “什么是新生风云榜？那是什么东西？”琼霄好奇的问道。

    “所谓新生风云榜，就是记录了刚进入学院时，新生所拥有的战绩！”

    “哦？说说！”

    “凡在风云榜中的人，都有着极强的战斗力，这是新生实力的象征。喏！给你，这是榜上人物！”说着，李朗丢给琼霄一卷黑色的卷轴。

    随手接住卷轴，旋即打开卷轴，一眼扫去，看到了一排密密麻麻的字体。

    他的视线从下往上看去，对于排在前十的人物，他也略感好奇，他想看看那些人究竟有着怎样的实力，看看这些人究竟如何妖孽……

    “风云榜第十！星辰帝国王玄，**境后期，在战斗中斩杀两名**境后期强者，进入星辰学院与玄星境初期的学长相斗，处于不败之地。”

    “风云榜第九，星辰帝国季影，**境后期巅峰！曾击败星辰学院玄星境初期的学长。”

    “风云榜第八，冰封王国长孙龙影，**境后期巅峰，极度嗜战，喜欢越级战斗，曾在冰封王国一次战斗中斩杀一名玄星境初期强者，在与玄星境中期强者战斗中全身而退，并且断人一臂！短短数天内统一了冰封王国所有新生！”

    “风云榜第七，大乾王朝杨浩，**境后期巅峰，与两名玄星境初期强者相战，并且斩敌于手下，统领大乾王朝新生队伍！”

    “风云榜第六，卡其顿帝国萧峰，玄星境初期，曾斩杀玄星境中期强者！卡其顿帝国新生队伍头领！”

    “风云榜第五，苍穹帝国沈天！玄星境初期，前天与卡其顿帝国萧峰相斗，并将其击败！苍穹帝国新生队伍代表！”

    “风云榜第四，新月国上官云，玄星境中期，曾与玄星境后期强者相斗，但不分胜负！新月国新生代表！”

    “风云榜第四星辰帝国，女，薛云儿，玄星境中期，战斗力惊人，在进入星辰学院时，由于长的太迷人，遭星辰学院玄星境后期的学长调戏，出手将其击败，并将其打成重伤！”

    “风云榜第三，死海中人祝融！玄星境后期，此人性情孤僻，而且极度嗜血，杀人无数，并有玄星境后期死在他的手中，在星辰学院中，同时挑战两位玄星境后期的学长，并将他们击败！”

    “风云榜第二，死海中人，廖君！与地星境初期强者相斗而不败！”
content_en:
A few days have passed since the graduation ceremony. I was meditating on the bed, "Qiong Xiao, Qiong Xiao!" A quick voice came from outside the door.

"What's wrong? You always make such a fuss!" Qiong Xiao, who was meditating, slowly opened his eyes and asked.

"Big deal! Absolutely big deal!" The person who came was none other than Li Lang, because in the freshman area, he and Qiong Xiao were the only ones living in the same room.

"What big thing could it be?" Qiong Xiao asked with a frown.

"I told you to go out often and collect information about the academy! What's the use of staying in your room all the time?"

"What do you know?" Qiong Xiao rolled his eyes helplessly. It's not that he doesn't want to go out. He has now come into contact with the Xuanxing Realm and wants to break through to the Xuanxing Realm, so during this period he can only practice in seclusion. Although he has the Xuanji Pill, he doesn't practice well. Even if he has the Xuanji Pill, the chance of breakthrough is very small, so he can't be distracted.

"Do you want to hear it?" Li Lang raised the corners of his mouth slightly and said with a smile.

"Hurry up, what's the big deal? Don't keep trying to tease me!" Qiong Xiao roared, pulling on Li Lang's lapel.

"Um, can you please stop being so rude?" Li Lang said speechlessly.

"Who told you that boy is dishonest? Hurry up and tell me. It's made me curious!"

"Okay! Let me tell you! Do you know the college freshmen ranking list?" Li Lang smiled.

"What is the Freshman Ranking? What is that?" Qiong Xiao asked curiously.

"The so-called freshman rankings record the achievements of freshmen when they first entered the academy!"

"Oh? Tell me!"

"Everyone on the list has extremely strong fighting power, which is a symbol of new strength. Here! Here, here are the people on the list!" As he said that, Li Lang threw a black scroll to Qiong Xiao.

He caught the scroll casually, opened it immediately, and glanced at it, seeing a dense row of fonts.

He looked up from the bottom, and he was also slightly curious about the top ten people. He wanted to see what kind of strength those people had, and how evil these people were...

"Tenth on the list! Wang Xuan of the Star Empire is in the late stage of the Xuanxing Realm. He killed two strong men in the late stage of the Xuanxing Realm in the battle. He entered the Star Academy to fight with the seniors in the early stage of the Xuanxing Realm. He is in an invincible position."

"Nineth on the Billboard Ranking, Star Empire Ji Ying, the peak of the late stage of the Xuanxing Realm! He once defeated the senior of Xingchen Academy in the early stage of the Xuanxing Realm."

"Eighth on the list, Long Ying, the eldest grandson of the Frozen Kingdom, is at the peak of the late stage of the Ice Realm. He is extremely war-loving and likes to fight across levels. He once killed a strong man in the early stage of the Xuan Star Realm in a battle in the Frozen Kingdom. He escaped with his whole body and broke an arm of a strong man in the middle stage of the Xuan Star Realm! He unified all the new students in the Frozen Kingdom in just a few days!"

"Seventh on the list of celebrities, Yang Hao of the Daqian Dynasty, who is at the peak of the late stage of the Xuanxing Realm, fought with two strong men in the early stage of the Xuanxing Realm, and killed the enemy, leading the new team of the Daqian Dynasty!"

"Sixth on the Most Popular Ranking, Xiao Feng of the Khacedonian Empire. In the early stage of the Mysterious Star Realm, he once killed a strong man in the middle stage of the Mysterious Star Realm! The leader of the new team of the Khakedon Empire!"

"Fifth on the most popular list, Shen Tian of the Sky Empire! In the early stage of the Xuanxing Realm, he fought against Xiao Feng of the Cacedonian Empire the day before yesterday and defeated him! Representative of the new team of the Sky Empire!"

"Fourth on the Most Popular Ranking, Shangguan Yun of the New Moon Kingdom. He is in the middle stage of the Mysterious Star Realm. He once fought against a strong person in the late stage of the Mysterious Star Realm, but there was no winner! A new representative of the New Moon Country!"

"The fourth star empire on the list, female, Xue Yun'er, is in the middle stage of the Xuanxing realm. Her combat power is astonishing. When she entered Xingchen Academy, because she was too charming, she was molested by the seniors of the Xingchen Academy who were in the late stage of the Xuanxing realm. She defeated her and severely injured her!"

"Third on the list of celebrities, Zhu Rong from the Dead Sea! In the late stage of Xuanxing Realm, this man was withdrawn and extremely bloodthirsty. He killed countless people, and some people in the late stage of Xuanxing Realm died in his hands. In Star Academy, he challenged two seniors in the late stage of Xuanxing Realm at the same time and defeated them!"

"Second on the most popular list, the man in the Dead Sea, Mr. Liao! He won a battle with a strong man in the early stage of the Earth Star Realm without losing!"
